source_requirements.text: Keep state jurisdiction and governing jurisdiction as distinct types; containment never grants authority.
Preserve the user-declared GOML/GSOL model and MCIR realization roles; bind existing native schemas.
Represent scoped actors, powers, delegation, expiry, revocation, appeals and explicit conflict resolution.
No identity, endorsement, publication, witness count or adoption declaration alone grants operation authority.
Canonical encodings, domain separation, explicit absence, strict schemas and migration rules are pinned and tested.
Preserve clean state identity, typed semantic bindings and point-of-use admissibility as separate objects/procedures.
Bind policy, root set, schema, operation, evidence snapshot and prior state to each evaluation; external observations are explicit inputs.
Support local, LAN, Internet and P2P acquisition through one verifier interface with policy-selected proof types.
Authenticate freshness evidence and persist anti-rollback state; equal checkpoints require the declared idempotent recheck conditions.
Keep strict, grace and emergency states explicit; unavailability cannot invent fresh evidence; known revocation is not ordinary grace.
Preserve the four revocation classes and only apply declared propagation rules.
Separate build, runtime, evidence and authority dependency graphs and their invalidation effects.
Compact manifest commitments do not imply available objects or a verified full dependency closure.
Keep arbitrary semantic equivalence proposals unresolved unless a scoped evidence-backed rule admits the relation.
Deterministic evaluation is total within declared resource bounds and replays from frozen inputs without ambient clocks/network.
Do not confuse conflicting same-scope publication histories with legitimate different-jurisdiction policies.
Apply verification to the object actually consumed, the operation and relevant handler/runtime dependencies; state the enforcement perimeter.
Keep proposal, construction, qualification, program admission, pilot authorization and activation as separate transitions.
Checkpoint/evidence commits survive specified crashes and retries; do not claim exactly-once external effects from a receipt journal.
Preserve local version selection; report fresh risk evidence without silently authorizing replacement.
Publication is opt-in and privacy-scoped; commitments and proof disclosure do not automatically establish unlinkability.
All tests identify the exact model, implementation, policy, oracle, target and evidence kind; fixture outcomes are not hardware witnesses.
Use real independent review/custody where required; never manufacture independence from signatures or agent names.
Bind native program/runtime/toolchain interfaces by exact custody, tests and translation equivalence obligations.
Model-only, source-bearing and binary-bearing publications remain distinct assurance profiles; opaque required dependencies block strong qualification.
Maintain recoverable baselines, migration evidence and scoped requalification after drift, policy change or incident.
The agent can propose and construct but cannot weaken its own acceptance oracle or self-authorize law changes.
Preserve source ambiguities as blocking issues rather than silently repairing the governing model.
Successful checks establish their stated bounded claims only, not truth of semantic claims or general software safety.
Use bounded inputs, parser limits, effect-scoped collectors and typed failure outcomes for hostile or malformed material.
Evaluate a coherent snapshot; changes between evaluation and use require a version-checked recheck or fresh evaluation.
Define ongoing-run/file-read policy separately from launch admission; revocation observation and action have bounded declared latency.

source_stages.instruction: Implement source-bound CHC verification/evaluation on frozen requests; resource-bounded policy, freshness failure taxonomy and anti-rollback.
source_stages.title: CHC point-of-use decision core

source_stages.instruction: Implement typed claims, adoption/endorsement separation, bounded semantic relationship handling, manifest profiles and private/public projections.
source_stages.title: Curation, stack selection and portable publication

source_stages.exit_criterion: All four modes feed the same decision interface; unsigned peer agreement, arrival order and response count never substitute for proof.
source_stages.instruction: Build effect-scoped collectors; capture raw evidence and verified context; test transport/federation failures in disposable local environments.
source_stages.title: Local/LAN/Internet/P2P evidence acquisition

source_stages.exit_criterion: Within declared paths, verify/use races, dependency drift and failure recovery are addressed; OS-wide mediation remains a separate hardware/adapter claim.
source_stages.instruction: Implement cooperative launch/file-open paths in disposable environments, binding exact objects, operations, interpreters and handlers.
source_stages.title: Point-of-use broker and observed-stack reconciliation

source_stages.exit_criterion: All applicable local/shadow obligations pass with preserved failed attempts; external or hardware obligations remain separately identified, not waived.
source_stages.instruction: Compose all branches, run the frozen matrix and negative controls, replay from clean extraction, and package one exact candidate.
source_stages.title: Integrated shadow qualification and frozen handoff

source_stages.exit_criterion: Required physical/native legs and independent custody evidence are obtained; absent hardware or witness material blocks the associated claim.
source_stages.instruction: Run explicitly authorized native targets and independently controlled evidence roles; retain measured environment and recovery conditions.
source_stages.title: Real target and independent witness qualification

source_stages.exit_criterion: All blocking findings are closed or remain explicit holds; reviewer acceptance does not authorize publication or activation.
source_stages.instruction: Review the exact integrated candidate once across all guarantees; make one consolidated repair successor and replay affected and non-regression obligations.
source_stages.title: Consolidated independent review and repair

source_stages.exit_criterion: Explicit target-specific authorization, independent recovery and reversible deployment are demonstrated; no global or fleet-wide authority follows.
source_stages.instruction: Present the qualified candidate and changes to the competent local authority; activate only the expressly authorized bounded pilot.
source_stages.title: Scoped pilot authorization and reversible activation

source_stages.exit_criterion: Defined incident scenarios and ongoing-use rules work within measured bounds; future changes re-enter the relevant gates rather than inherit acceptance.
source_stages.instruction: Operate only within separately authorized policy; track evidence freshness, drift, revocation, repairs, recovery and release succession.
source_stages.title: Continuity, incidents and scoped requalification
